description: This Java source file defines the class EventDeliveryPool, which manages a thread pool for delivering events asynchronously via event adapter classes. It includes mechanisms for scheduling event notification tasks in a thread pool, with nested classes handling the execution of these tasks.

classes.name: EventDeliveryPool
classes.description: Manages a singleton thread pool for event notification, providing methods to schedule event delivery tasks.
